extraction_notes: IDSS maximum is 10 uA at VDS=640 V, VGS=0 V. Gate charge typicals are Qg=46 nC, Qgs1=13 nC, Qgd=18 nC at VDD approximately 400 V, VGS=10 V, ID=10 A.
Body-diode typical reverse recovery is trr=1200 ns and Qrr=12 uC at IDR=10 A, VGS=0 V, -dIDR/dt=100 A/us. Thermal resistances are Rth(ch-c)=2.5 degC/W and Rth(ch-a)=62.5 degC/W.

Figures 8.1, 8.2, 8.3 and 8.9 contain real output, transfer, and capacitance traces with Ta=25 degC and pulse-test labels. They were omitted because the supplied context requires a numeric pulse_width_s for pulsed curves, while the datasheet states no pulse width for these figures. No pulse width was invented.
omission_reason: The datasheet has output, transfer, and capacitance plots, but they are labeled pulse test without a numeric pulse width. The supplied extraction rules require pulse_width_s for pulsed curves, so no curve was retained.
